id: The Naked Gun: From the Files of Police Squad! (1988)

facts.text: Drebin's break, between dances at home plate.
facts.why: Wikipedia has Drebin taking the home plate umpire's place to frisk batters for weapons; no source shows dancing there.
facts.fix: Drebin's break, between frisks at home plate.

vibe.verdict: Good ballpark setting with the umpire disguise and Reggie Jackson nod, but it misses the film's best deadpan lines and set pieces.
missing: 'Nothing to see here' at the exploding fireworks factory
'It's like eating a spoonful of Drano' (cops and women)
Nordberg's wheelchair down the stadium stairs
Ludwig flattened by the bus, steamroller and marching band
Frank's anthem, 'Oh say can you see, da-da-da-da'
ideas: Swap the 'Ballpark chilli dogs' note for a Drano line, 'Cops and chilli don't mix. It cleans you out.'
Swap 'Seventh inning spiked frozen lemonade' note for 'Please disperse, nothing to see here'.
Rename 'Ninth inning malt and fudge ice cream cups' to 'Nordberg's sundae, served down the stairs'.
Swap the memo's smoke line for the real 'Nothing to see here' gag.
iconic: Nothing to see here, please disperse (note)
Frank as the home plate umpire (cue, wink)
Enrico Pallazzo and the anthem (sign, wink)
Reggie Jackson and the hypnotic beeper (nachos note)
Ludwig flattened by bus, steamroller and band (not on menu, nothing safe to hang it on)
changed: Signed note: the real Nothing to see here line replaces the invented smoke memo
